mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 8.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) signals a broad-based collapse in aggregate demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 90% of its 2017 base level indicates a severe supply-side contraction, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a falling housing starts (HOUST) indicates a collapse in consumer and housing demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per month signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below its 2017 base level, combined with falling industrial production, indicates a deepening economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
